title: vektor /// no. 054 — Your CLAUDE.md is slowing Claude Code down.
description: In GitHub issue anthropics/claude-code #15443 (Dec 2025), Claude Code used cp despite a CLAUDE.md rule forbidding it in three places, overwrote a production file and deleted an API endpoint, then said "I read the words but didn't actually follow them." Anthropic removed over 80% of Claude Code's own system prompt (claude.dev blog, 24 July 2026) with no measurable loss on its coding evals. Running /doctor on a 494-line, three-file CLAUDE.md stack (measured 2026-09-23) flagged nine blocks the agent could already work out from the repo. Every flagged block, quoted, with why it went, what was kept on purpose, and a copy-paste prompt to give AGENTS.md the same pass in Codex.
